# Aqua Theme Showcase

Welcome to the **Aqua** theme showcase for MemWault. Inspired by early macOS X, this theme features heavily glossy buttons, pinstriped backgrounds, and the iconic liquid-like interface elements.

## Dashboard & Navigation

The dashboard uses pinstripes and glossy, translucent panels.
